schoolName: The Maldives National University — School of Medicine
reviewNotes: HOLD — this is a strong source base, but not yet a complete commercial/international payload. MNU's current Doctor of Medicine page confirms a five-year, full-time MNQF Level 7 programme in Malé, an August 2026 deadline of 30 July 2026, a course-fee figure of MVR 616,800 specifically marked applicable to the Free First Degree Scheme, and a general-entry/pre-medicine selection route. MQA lists MNU programmes and MNU announced in June 2026 that GMC confirmed its primary medical qualification currently meets acceptable-overseas-qualification criteria. Yet the current evidence does not establish international applicant eligibility or a separate international fee, the exact fee inclusion/exclusions, primary source clinical-placement/internship arrangements, accommodation and student support, or a complete admissions document list. The Free First Degree fee must not be presented as a price for an international applicant. Hold until these gaps have primary evidence.
